_comment: The comparison set for `road-to-a-setup-that-decides-itself` step 0.2 — the cases Phase 5 reads when it compares today's full rule layer against the computed form. ONE MANIFEST, BY REUSE: the step's whole point is that no new frozen corpus is authored, so every present source names an artefact the tree already carries and a resolver that reads it. A source the tree does NOT carry is recorded as `absent` with the reason and the condition that reopens it, never swapped for whatever happened to be measurable — the form `road-to-skills-that-arrive-when-called` 5.1 used on 2026-10-20 for the same missing artefact. Read by src/scripts/_lib/layer_form_corpus.ts; checked by tests/scripts/layer_form_corpus.test.ts.

sources.what: Per-rule positives and near-misses: a prompt and the skills it must reach. The near-miss half is what a thinned layer would regress first, which is why the matrix is the primary source rather than a supporting one.

The train slice of the trigger corpus, through `loadTrainCases`. The sealed holdout is never opened: the partition is decided from the skill directory name before any file is read, so the seal is kept by refusal and not by filtering.

The class the step adds: one case per rule that must fire under every input — every member of the consequence class, plus every rule whose frontmatter carries `tier: safety-floor`. These are the cases D2 fixes at a zero margin, so they are derived from the frontmatter that decides the class rather than listed here.

sources.why: `tests/conformance/` holds one set, `retrieval/`, and it validates the v1 retrieval ENVELOPE against its schema. It carries no prompt and no expectation, so it cannot be an arm of a comparison between two rule layers. Naming it the step's `conformance cases` would be the guess this step forbids.
sources.reopens_when: A conformance set exists whose rows carry a prompt and an adjudicated expectation — then it joins this manifest as a present source and Phase 5's primary reads it.

sources.why: No artefact named `host-graded cases` exists in the tree. `road-to-a-setup-that-decides-itself` recorded that on 2026-10-16, and `road-to-skills-that-arrive-when-called` step 5.1 reached the same reading on 2026-10-20 and declared its own primary unmeasurable rather than substituting for it.
sources.reopens_when: A host-graded case set is committed — a set whose rows are graded by what a host actually did with them, not by an offline ranker. Until then Phase 5's primary reads the three present sources and says so.

what_this_does_not_bound: The margin. D2 fixes it — zero regressions on the obligation source, at most one regressed case per hundred elsewhere, valid only under a powered pre-registration — and 5.1 freezes it before the first run. A manifest that also carried the margin would let a corpus edit move a threshold.
